objective: Improve small-plant localization and fragment deduplication, run real agricultural instance detection, and seek weed precision >= .90, recall >= .60, crop-as-weed <= .05 before resuming any video work.
previous_confirmation: 20 previously inspected val images, 78 weeds: original 2 TP, whole SAM + ERFNet 25 TP/26 predictions, tiled hybrid 31 TP/39 predictions. Diagnostic comparisons only.
agricultural_instance_model: Official PhenoBench YOLOv7 plant detection, pretrained by authors; no GreenPoint training. Faster R-CNN optional second official baseline if useful.

data_selection.development: 20 new official val images for threshold and postprocessing calibration; exclude all previous 45 and smoke image.
data_selection.confirmation: Next 40 new official val images in SHA256(seed:filename) order, image-disjoint from calibration and every prior image; frozen before inference.
data_selection.scope: Same public sugar-beet domain. Author checkpoint may have used official val for model selection. Neither independent-farm validation nor Japanese phone-camera validation.

optimization: Use calibration images only. Freeze complete score thresholds, tile geometry, merging and expert-verification rule before confirmation scoring. No repeated tuning on final images. Do not drop failures, partial plants or small annotations.
metrics: Same class-agnostic one-to-one greedy box IoU >= .5 as prior experiment. Weed precision/recall, crop-as-weed, small-target bins <=32/33-64/65-128/>128 source pixels. Pixel IoU separate.
guardrails: RGB alone enters inference; annotations are scoring-only.
Model weights from official sources; inspect checkpoint globals and use restricted weight loading.
Do not claim original pretrained weights or training as ours.
Do not claim a passed target unless the frozen method passes on the complete new confirmation cohort.
